latestTerminalSummary:
Completed one four-arm run + exactly two smoke evaluations. **Teacher still weak.** All checkpoints, receipts, and logs retained.

Every arm: **8 epochs, 632 optimizer steps, 40,000 optimized samples**, seed 7, 430,474 parameters.

| Arm | Held-out accuracy | Balanced accuracy | Enemy TV max / mean | Precondition passed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Baseline | 73.6% | 37.86% | 0.006213 / 0.001025 | false |
| Prior | 72.8% | 37.95% | 0.008784 / 0.002300 | false |
| Relative | 75.1% | 46.14% | 0.165157 / 0.008913 | false |
| Combined | 75.5% | 43.59% | 0.152589 / 0.009897 | false |

Per-action recall (%):

| Action | Baseline | Prior | Relative | Combined |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| neutral | 95.93 | 94.72 | 93.67 | 95.17 |
| up | 23.08 | 17.31 | 21.15 | 23.08 |
| down | 28.81 | 44.07 | 44.07 | 40.68 |
| left | 17.39 | 19.57 | 43.48 | 34.78 |
| right | 41.38 | 20.69 | 34.48 | 39.66 |
| up_left | 20.83 | 29.17 | 33.33 | 29.17 |
| up_right | 4.55 | 15.91 | 27.27 | 31.82 |
| down_left | 67.57 | 64.86 | 64.86 | 56.76 |
| down_right | 41.18 | 35.29 | 52.94 | 41.18 |

Manifest + all 10 live code hashes matched before training and after evaluation. JSON checks passed. Train/smoke identity hashes, minibatch order, and training budgets matched across arms. All four checkpoints use entity schema 2 and retain optimizer state.

- Train: **50,000 frames, 5,000 samples**. Smoke dataset: **5,000 frames, 1,000 samples**.
- Collection: **55,000 native frames + 55,000 avoidance-label queries**, excluding startup.
- Supervised run: **471.106 s / 1,200 s**. Arm times, table order: **105.345 / 106.048 / 106.573 / 107.239 s**, each below 300 s.
- Dataset estimate: **579,802,740 bytes**, below 2,147,483,648-byte cap. **Peak process RSS: 3,419,783,168 bytes (3.185 GiB).** Runner caps dataset memory; whole-process usage exceeded 2 GiB.

Relative won held-out balanced accuracy. Evaluated report-listed [baseline.pt](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/runs/teacher-representation-ablation-r1/baseline.pt) and [relative.pt](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/runs/teacher-representation-ablation-r1/relative.pt), sequentially:

| Policy | Mean survival frames | Pattern completions |
|---|---:|---:|
| Baseline teacher | 188.5 | 0 |
| Relative teacher | 188.5 | 0 |
| Neutral, both evaluations | 188.5 | 0 |
| Random, both evaluations | 260.9 | 0 |
| Avoidance, both evaluations | 1,000 | 4 each |

Each evaluation covered 10 smoke seeds × four policies. Times: **17.618 / 17.803 s**, each below 300 s. Gameplay used **32,818 native frames across 80 episodes**; campaign counted **87,818 frames**, excluding startup.

[Run + full-precision metrics](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/runs/teacher-representation-ablation-r1/run.json) · [Baseline smoke](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/runs/teacher-representation-ablation-r1/baseline-smoke-gameplay.json) · [Relative smoke](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/runs/teacher-representation-ablation-r1/relative-smoke-gameplay.json) · [All artifacts](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/runs/teacher-representation-ablation-r1)

The 0.90 accuracy + 0.20 max-TV gate is diagnostic; no qualification established. No PPO, student work, validation/test evaluation, source edits, retries, or publishing.

Next discriminating step: teacher-only action audit against avoidance on teacher-visited smoke states, testing where behavior collapses to neutral-level outcomes. No further run started.
